description: Time-averages the spectrum over a window of analysis frames, smearing spectral content across time. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Softens transients, washes out spectral detail, produces hazy or fogged-out versions of the source. Good for turning percussive material into spectral pads, or for blending a sound with itself over time. It needs internal change to bite: plucked and percussive attacks soften dramatically, while near-static sounds barely alter (each blur group only interpolates between its start and end windows, so similar windows mean little audible difference). A breakpoint file ramping blurring from low at the start to high at the end lets a sound dissolve gradually into its own ambience — a simple, powerful route to ambient washes.

blurring.description: Number of analysis windows to average over. Larger values produce more smearing. Accepts a breakpoint list for time-varying blur — e.g., [[0.0, 5], [1.0, 50]] to ramp from 5 to 50 windows over the input duration.

examples.expected_use: Soften the attack of a percussive spectral source while preserving overall pitch content.
